(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Excel_Generation260_') AS OLE_DB_Source_TableName,

(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279_') AS _COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279_') AS _COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279_') AS _COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CIRS_ERROR_RREPORTING' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = '_COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279_') AS _COPYDATAMoveToBusFolder_CC279__sink_TableName;
